summary: Completed first full e2e testing of Delhi NCR Event Planner. Backend pytest 22/22 passing (public packages/gallery/testimonials/leads, auth, all admin CRUD, image upload+serve, analytics). Frontend home loads with Hero, 7 event cards, 21 packages, 9 gallery items, 3 testimonials, contact form. WhatsApp links correctly point to wa.me/918796306375. Admin login, dashboard stats+chart, leads list/filter, packages CRUD (21 rows + edit/duplicate/delete buttons), testimonials, gallery, logout and protected-route redirect all functional. Package detail page navigation works. Contact form submission shows success toast.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate data-testid='contact-phone' on two elements: the <a href='tel:...'> link in the contact info column AND the Mobile Number form Input (Input subcomponent renders data-testid={id} from id='contact-phone'). Causes test scripts that use the testid to resolve to the anchor first and fail to fill the form input. Suggested fix: change anchor to data-testid='contact-phone-link' or change Input id to 'contact-phone-input'.

action_items: Resolve duplicate data-testid='contact-phone' between ContactSection tel-anchor and the form Input (line 64 vs line 108 in /app/frontend/src/components/ContactSection.jsx).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 612 lines, mostly clean. Consider splitting into routers/ (public, auth, admin_*) if it grows further.

JWT secret is hardcoded in .env which is fine, but cookie is set with secure=False - acceptable since prod likely uses secure=True via env-driven flag; consider making secure configurable for production deploys.
leads/admin endpoints accept arbitrary status strings; could add Pydantic Literal validation for known statuses (New/Contacted/Booked/Lost) to avoid bad data.
Public /api/files/{path} streams images via remote storage on every call without caching headers; consider Cache-Control headers for marketing performance.
init_storage() uses a module-level global; concurrent first-time calls could race. Low risk for current scale.
Frontend Input/Select subcomponent sets data-testid={id} which creates collisions with other data-testid attributes that share the same string (root cause of contact-phone duplicate).

success_rate.frontend: ~98% (all critical flows pass; one minor data-testid duplicate)

seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 21 packages, 3 testimonials, 9 gallery items, 1 admin on first startup. Tests created and cleaned up several TEST_* leads, packages, testimonials, gallery items; some TEST_ leads remain in DB intentionally to confirm list/filter (a few leftover from create_lead and admin lead tests).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all public + admin endpoints incl. upload/serve via real Emergent object storage. All passing. Frontend e2e via Playwright confirmed: home page (hero/stats/events/packages/gallery/testimonials/contact), WhatsApp prefilled links (wa.me/918796306375), package detail page, gallery lightbox open (close via X button works; backdrop close works when clicking outside the image - inner image has stopPropagation), contact form submission toast 'Thank you! We'll reach out to you within 24 hours.', and full admin CRUD nav + logout + protected route redirect. Only outstanding nit: duplicate data-testid='contact-phone'.
rca of the issue: Duplicate testid root cause: shared Input/Select component in ContactSection renders data-testid from the id prop. Because the contact-info column anchor link explicitly uses data-testid='contact-phone' for the tel: link and the form's Mobile Number Input has id='contact-phone' (which gets cloned to data-testid), both elements end up with the same testid. Fix: rename either the anchor's testid to 'contact-phone-link' or the Input's id to 'contact-phone-input' and update tests accordingly.
